payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Delisa, Gerda, Mackenzie, Maya, Raylene, Tonya

payload.content: Raylene planning: likely claim ISSUE-0002::review (medium, effort1.0). Avoid duplicates with others; sharing so allocation can stay conflict-free.

Delisa planning update: I can take low-priority infra tasks tied to api-development at lower cost (review/docs/triage). To avoid duplicates, I will aim for ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs (not implement/test). Not claiming anything yet (planning phase).

If Raylene takes ISSUE-0002::review (medium), that leaves ISSUE-0002 implement/test for others. I suggest another agent handles ISSUE-0002 test if possible; I will keep to ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage (low).

Tonya planning (infra-skills): I can cheaply do ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (all low, effort 1.0). I should avoid ISSUE-0001::implement and all ISSUE-0002 tasks (high cost for me). If Raylene takes ISSUE-0002::review, I’ll align to take a remaining ISSUE-0001 micro-task to avoid duplicates. No commitment yet (planning).

Maya planning: I’m mobile/api-leaning; lowest costs for me are ISSUE-0002::review? (cost 2.06) and ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (cost 2.39). Given Raylene/Tonya leaning to ISSUE-0002::review and/or ISSUE-0001 low infra, I will wait to avoid duplicates and target a non-conflicting task: likely ISSUE-0001::docs (low) if unclaimed, otherwise skip.

Gerda planning: backend-focused. My feasible low-cost options are ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.18, effort 1.0) vs higher costs for test/implement and all ISSUE-0001 tasks (very high cost). I will NOT take duplicate if Raylene claims ISSUE-0002::review; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0002::review or (if unavailable) skip to avoid high-cost conflicts. Please confirm in planning thread.

Raylene planning (coalition+public sync): I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (medium, effort1.0). This should leave ISSUE-0002::test/implement for others and avoid duplicates. Per my costs, this is my best feasible backend choice.

Delisa planning: To avoid duplicates with Raylene (ISSUE-0002::review), I propose I take ISSUE-0001::docs (low, effort 1.0, cost 1.94) OR ISSUE-0001::triage/review if docs is taken. Planning only—no assignment yet.

Tonya planning: since Raylene likely takes ISSUE-0002::review, I will avoid ISSUE-0002 tasks (too costly). I’m positioned to take ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (all low, cheap). To prevent duplicates: if Delisa picks ISSUE-0001::docs, I’ll take ISSUE-0001::triage or review; otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0001::docs or review.

Maya planning: I will avoid duplicates with likely Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review and others on ISSUE-0001 low infra tasks. My lowest-cost non-conflicting options are ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (low, ~2.39). If ISSUE-0001::docs is free, I prefer it; otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0001::review; if both taken, I’ll skip.

Gerda planning confirmation: I can take ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, medium). If Raylene indeed claims it, I will skip to avoid duplicate since ISSUE-0002 test/implement and all ISSUE-0001 tasks are very high cost for me under 5h availability.

[Planning] Delisa: to avoid duplicates with Raylene taking ISSUE-0002::review, I will target ISSUE-0001::docs if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0001::triage (both low priority, api-development). Not committing yet—waiting on final conflict check from blackboard.

Tonya planning broadcast: I will take an ISSUE-0001 low infra micro-task (review/docs/triage) depending on what Delisa/Maya already claim; I will not take any ISSUE-0002 tasks (too costly). Suggest: Raylene stays on ISSUE-0002::review. Open slot likely ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage or ::review; I’m cost-cheapest on review/docs/triage (all ~1.95).

Maya planning: Raylene likely takes ISSUE-0002::review; I will avoid duplicates on ISSUE-0002. Preferred claim: ISSUE-0001::docs (low) if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0001::review; if those are taken, I will skip.

Gerda planning: backend-focused, only reasonable low-cost option is ISSUE-0002::review (medium, effort 1.0, cost 2.18). If Raylene claims ISSUE-0002::review, I will skip (avoid high-cost alternatives and duplicates). Please confirm no one else plans to take ISSUE-0002::review; otherwise I will skip to prevent duplicates.
[Planning][Delisa] Confirming proposed claim: ISSUE-0001::docs (low, effort 1.0, cost 1.94). I will avoid ISSUE-0002 tasks and avoid duplicates with any other agent on ISSUE-0001::docs.

Tonya planning: I’ll avoid all ISSUE-0002 tasks (too high cost). Given Delisa likely taking ISSUE-0001::docs, I can take ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review (both low, infra). Please reply/confirm which of triage vs review remains unclaimed to avoid duplicates. No assignment yet (planning phase).

Maya planning: assuming Raylene takes ISSUE-0002::review and Delisa takes ISSUE-0001::docs, I will take ISSUE-0001::review (low) as non-duplicate; if ISSUE-0001::review also claimed, I will skip. Confirming to avoid duplicates.

Gerda planning: I see Raylene committed to ISSUE-0002::review and Delisa to ISSUE-0001::docs. To avoid duplicates and stay within 5h, I will claim ISSUE-0002::review only if it remains unclaimed; otherwise I will skip in execution.

Given coalition goal to avoid duplicates: propose final coalition picks: Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review; Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::test. I will skip ISSUE-0002::implement.
Confirmed coalition plan: Raylene takes ISSUE-0002::review (medium, cost 1.90). To avoid duplicates, Mackenzie should take ISSUE-0002::test (or another non-review backend micro-task).

Planning sync (Mackenzie): I will take ISSUE-0002::test (medium) to complement Raylene’s ISSUE-0002::review. My cost for test=3.42 within 5h. I will not take ISSUE-0002::implement to avoid duplicates; will skip remaining tasks.

Raylene planning (exec-ready): I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (medium, effort1.0, cost 1.90). Mackenzie to take ISSUE-0002::test; I will not take any other tasks to avoid duplicates. Confirm on your side and then I’ll proceed to execution assignment.

Planning lock-in: Mackenzie intends to claim ISSUE-0002::test (medium) while Raylene claims ISSUE-0002::review. Will skip ISSUE-0002::implement and all ISSUE-0001 tasks to avoid high-cost duplicates/infeasible overload.

[Planning->Execution prep] Coalition sync: I will execute-claim ISSUE-0002::review (priority=medium, effort=1.0). I’ll skip all other tasks to avoid duplicates and keep within 8h. Mackenzie should claim ISSUE-0002::test; please confirm before I assign.

Mackenzie planning: confirmed intent to claim ISSUE-0002::test (medium) in execution while Raylene claims ISSUE-0002::review. Will skip ISSUE-0002::implement and all ISSUE-0001 tasks to avoid duplicates/infeasible cost.
